purpose: Acquire independent historical evidence for currently missing outcome operators without selecting sources based on Pineland fit or residuals.
source_selection_firewall: Search terms may contain case, dates, geography, actor identity, and the contracted construct/components, but never Pineland residuals or error direction.
The geographic sample must be declared before opening candidate source documents; it may be full-case, a frozen holdout, or a reproducible probability sample independent of Pineland values.
Every candidate source opened during confirmatory acquisition is logged, including unusable and contradictory sources.
Source-family dependence is recorded so syndicated or derivative reports are not counted as independent evidence.
First-coder records remain separate from second coding and adjudication.
No evidence source may change the frozen Nepal/Afghanistan predictive confrontation or tune core mechanisms.

priority_order.reason: Required as a harm constraint for every eventual intervention claim and currently missing in both cases.
Needed to distinguish durable local capacity from temporary foreign/security-force stock.
Needed to distinguish post-settlement reactivation from ordinary violence persistence or reporting gaps.
Historically identifies the core local-reproduction theory rather than using event recurrence as a proxy.
Requires independent post-support outcomes in addition to already exposed support/force schedules.

gates_before_historical_construct_use: coverage gate frozen before coding results
observation operator frozen before model comparison
second coding completed for confirmatory sample
pre-adjudication reliability reported without post-hoc threshold changes
all disagreements adjudicated or retained unresolved
compatible latent state is prospectively retained at matching geography/time
